question: Could you provide the highest recorded precipitation, minimum temperature, and maximum temperature from the last 15 days of each year from 2013 to 2016 at weather station USW00094846? Ensure each value represents the peak measurement for that period, with precipitation in millimeters and temperatures in degrees Celsius, using only validated data (non-null values and no quality flags)
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS INT64) AS year,
    element,
    value / 10.0 AS value_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
    AND date >= '2013-12-17'
    AND date <= '2016-12-31'
    -- Filter to last 15 days of each year: Dec 17-31
    AND (
      (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2013 AND date >= '2013-12-17') OR
      (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2014 AND date >= '2014-12-17') OR
      (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2015 AND date >= '2015-12-17') OR
      (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2016 AND date >= '2016-12-17')
    )
    AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value_c END) AS max_precipitation_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value_c END) AS min_temperature_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value_c END) AS max_temperature_c
FROM filtered
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
